authorize.title: Authorize Home Assistant
authorize.description:
**Option 1 — Sign in via your browser** (recommended)

1. Open your browser's developer tools (`F12` or `Ctrl+Shift+I` / `Cmd+Opt+I`), switch to the **Network** tab, and enable **Preserve log**. Leave it open for the whole flow.
2. Open this URL in the same browser tab:

    {auth_url}

3. Sign in to SharkClean and complete any verification SharkNinja prompts you for.
4. After login, your browser will land on a SharkNinja branding page — that's expected. The real callback is a `com.sharkninja.shark://...` redirect your browser can't follow.
5. In the Network tab, find the entry whose URL starts with `com.sharkninja.shark://` (it will contain `?code=...&state=...`). Right-click → **Copy** → **Copy link address**, and paste it below.

**Option 2 — Paste shark2mqtt tokens**

If you've used [shark2mqtt](https://github.com/CamSoper/shark2mqtt) to log in already, paste the contents of `shark2mqtt_tokens.json` instead.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authorize Home Assistant
reauth_confirm.description:
**Option 1 — Sign in via your browser** (recommended)

1. Open your browser's developer tools (`F12` or `Ctrl+Shift+I` / `Cmd+Opt+I`), switch to the **Network** tab, and enable **Preserve log**.
2. Open this URL in the same browser tab:

    {auth_url}

3. Sign in to SharkClean and complete any verification SharkNinja prompts you for.
4. After login you'll land on a SharkNinja branding page — that's expected. In the Network tab, find the entry whose URL starts with `com.sharkninja.shark://` and contains `?code=...&state=...`. Right-click → **Copy** → **Copy link address**, and paste it below.

**Option 2 — Paste shark2mqtt tokens**

Paste the contents of `shark2mqtt_tokens.json` instead.
